title: In Chennai’s beachside food, the secret ingredient is the sea
summary: Beach food may be hard to recreate at home because its flavour comes from more than just the masala: the salt, the sticky air, the sound of the waves, sand clinging to your feet, and the easy abandon with which people arrive at the beach simply to have fun

title: Pune tribal students continue hunger strike for 10th consecutive day
summary: Students demanded that allowances and other financial provisions to be linked to the Consumer Price Index so that they increase annually in line with inflation.

title: How Chennai city went from tiffin carriers to food apps
summary: As Chennai turns 387, a look at how its food culture has evolved—from home-cooked meals and old Madras favourites to street food, global cuisines, cafés and app-based meal subscriptions

title: Three newborns die in fire at government hospital’s NICU in Amravati, Maharashtra
summary: A ventilator in the NICU on the third floor of the district women’s hospital suddenly sparked at 3.15 a.m., triggering a fire in the unit; six infants admitted to a super speciality hospital, officials said
